# Speech test fixtures

`jfk.wav` — 11 s of John F. Kennedy's inaugural address (1961), 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM, from `samples/jfk.wav` of [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp). A work of the U.S. federal government, it is in the public domain.

The model the tests recognize it with is downloaded, not committed: `node scripts/fetch-speech-test-model.mjs`.
